notes: The priest and founder now have a different layout: Users Status and Users Data show how each user is doing with their tasks.
new: Users Status tab (replaces Chapel for the priest and founder): who did how many tasks today, in the last 7 days or the last 30 days.
Users Data on the Home quick actions (replaces Preparation for the priest and founder): each user's profile, tasks done, active days and recent tasks.
The priest and founder can still set the Mass language and write the crew note, now from Users Status.
changed: Chapel and Preparation are hidden from the priest and founder's tab bar and quick actions.
